notes: Mining ore, hauling it up to sell against a limited backpack, buying pickaxe tiers at the Forge and luck at the Altar is the extraction grind, so this is Simulation with no second genre earning a place. Shape is world-underground because the game is the descending mine beneath a surface facility, which is what the Mining & Extraction preset builds; I considered hub-portals and rejected it as the shape because the hub exists to feed the mine rather than to be the space, and I dropped the preset's hauling roads since ore travels in a 5x5 backpack rather than by vehicle. The route carries the shape's own P2 and P3 for the stacked cave layers and the surface-to-cave transition, plus P4 because the author chose three lobby places linked by portals rather than one connected surface. Deciding without a user: only the first five depths are built geometry per the author, with the Cave Arena chasm read as five descending tiers about 300 studs deep; the pickaxe-and-level requirements land on the purchase-gate option with its wording bent from paying to qualifying, and the portals themselves have no option row, so they show up only as that P4.
